description: This Swift file defines the `AnyCodable` struct, a lightweight wrapper that allows encoding and decoding of heterogeneously-typed JSON payloads using Codable. It handles various types including primitives, collections, and nulls, enabling flexibility in JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: AnyCodable
classes.description: A `Codable`, `Hashable`, and `Sendable` wrapper that can encapsulate any value compatible with JSON, supporting nested collections and primitive types.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes an `AnyCodable` with a value, normalizing certain types for consistent encoding.

methods.name: init(from decoder: Decoder)
methods.description: Custom initializer for decoding from a Codable decoder, attempting to decode into supported types.

methods.name: encode(to encoder: Encoder)
methods.description: Encodes the stored value into a Codable encoder, handling various supported types.
Equality operator to compare two `AnyCodable` instances based on their underlying values.

methods.name: hash(into hasher: inout Hasher)
methods.description: Hashes the `AnyCodable`'s underlying value, support for use in hashed collections.
